category_title: Reluctant stayers who use inappropriate language and avoid academic tasks
scenario_title: Prevocational English drafting in computer lab
minimal_context: The student is in a computer lab working on drafting a persuasive marketing brochure for an assessment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your computer and start drafting your persuasive marketing brochure.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This business proposal is bullshit. It's too hard and completely irrelevant to me. I'm literally only at school so I don't have to be unemployed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to keep working on the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and walks away from the computer) I'm not doing it. I'm going over to the other desks to talk.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come back to your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Fuck off, I'm not going back to my desk. I've been in this lab for 70 minutes and I haven't typed a single word of this crap, and I'm not starting now.
